title: ageratina saxorum
intro: Ageratina saxorum, commonly known as Wood's Rose, is a plant species in the mint family (Lamiaceae). It is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and relieving pain. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and analgesic, making it useful in treating conditions such as arthritis, menstrual cramps, and headaches. The bioactive constituents of Ageratina saxorum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
